reason: Publishes workspace files as durable chat artifacts, rendering supported raster images inline and presenting other files as downloadable cards.

summaries.zh: 将工作区文件发布为持久化聊天工件，支持在对话中内联显示栅格图像，并为其他文件提供下载卡片。
summaries.en: Publishes workspace files as durable chat artifacts, showing supported raster images inline and providing download cards for other files.

capabilities: Reads workspace files selected for publication
Stores artifact blobs and metadata locally
Serves artifact previews and downloads through HTTP endpoints
Adds artifact publication events to session logs
Renders supported images inline in the chat UI
